mission: Train every DreamCo bot to use every declared capability, discoverable tool and callable function to its safest measurable full potential; continuously diagnose and repair broken bots; and keep Buddy evolving with lawful open-source models, datasets, libraries, runtimes, agent frameworks and research techniques.
applies_to: every canonical bot, shared capability, tool adapter, callable function, model route, data package and builder path
full_potential_rule: For every capability/tool/function, test normal use, advanced composition, efficiency, recovery, adversarial inputs, permissions, cross-tool orchestration, user-effort reduction, competitor parity and reusable skill creation. Full potential means best verified performance inside safety, permission, legal, cost and resource boundaries; it never means bypassing those boundaries.

steps: check whether failure is shared infrastructure or bot-specific
run competing repair candidates in isolated branches/workspaces
retest dependent bots when shared infrastructure changed
update benchmark gap and Council career status
never: weaken required thresholds merely to pass

skill_building_loop: turn lesson into reusable skill card/fixture
promote reusable win to shared fleet infrastructure
advance Council career stage when evidence supports it

open_source_evolution.goal: As lawful open-source AI advances, Buddy discovers, evaluates, learns from and where appropriate integrates or independently reproduces useful public techniques so DreamCo does not freeze at today's capabilities.
source_policy: prefer official project repositories, model/data cards, papers and documentation
record source, version/commit, date, license and provenance
public availability is not redistribution permission
separate model weights license, code license, dataset license and commercial-use rights
never silently ingest private or access-controlled data
do not copy restricted training data merely because a model references it
open_source_evolution.cadence: continuous discovery with bounded scheduled refresh and event-driven checks when new releases/security changes are detected

open_data_learning.goal: Build a lawful universal index of open/licensed datasets and their usable skill/data-package value without claiming to literally ingest all data on the internet.

actions_integration.fleet: generate full-potential sandbox catalog and bot curriculum before fleet verification
actions_integration.full: include repair/open-source evolution governance checks in broad verification
actions_integration.failure_handoff: Buddy Debugger receives failing evidence and follows broken_bot_repair_loop

truth_rule: This program defines exhaustive training, repair and evolution coverage. Planned categories are not executed passes. Open-source discovery can be broad but cannot literally guarantee complete knowledge of every model, dataset or repository; status must be based on indexed sources and current evidence.
